purpose: G0 V3 counterexample matrix (DESIGN REVIEW; static counterexamples are not test results)

cases.title: duplicate FORKED, consecutive seq, completed

credibility.basis: ledger and durable copy agree; a duplicate cannot be produced by loss

cases.title: duplicate REGISTERED with a different pid, completed

credibility.basis: ledger and durable copy agree

cases.title: duplicate RELEASED, consecutive seq, completed

credibility.basis: ledger and durable copy agree

cases.title: REGISTERED, RELEASED, then a second REGISTERED, completed

credibility.basis: ledger and durable copy agree; ordering is judged on FIRST occurrences, the duplicate is the violation

cases.title: duplicate FORKED, early stop

credibility.basis: ledger and durable copy agree

cases.title: REGISTERED with starttime null, completed

credibility.basis: field type is visible in the ledger itself

cases.title: REGISTERED with starttime null, early stop

credibility.basis: field type is visible in the ledger itself

cases.title: FORKED with pid as string, early stop

credibility.basis: field type is visible in the ledger itself

cases.title: early stop; FORKED line lost from the durable copy (ledger has it)

credibility.basis: the ledger shows a complete sequence (first-hand) but the durable copy lost a line, so nothing may be concluded from the file

cases.title: early stop; FORKED never written, contiguous seq, writer clean

credibility.basis: ledger gapless, writer_clean, durable copy identical: the record was never attempted (owner policy: REGISTERED without FORKED is FAIL when integrity is proven)

cases.title: completed run without FORKED, contiguous

credibility.basis: as CE-F2, run completed

cases.title: append of RELEASED failed (ENOSPC), RUN_END(false) got seq 6

credibility.basis: the missing record is explained by a failed append (reg_writer_seq 6 != 5 ledger records); no protocol claim can be made

cases.title: completed run; DEAD and RUN_END lost from the durable copy (ledger complete)

credibility.basis: ledger shows a compliant, completed run (first-hand); the durable copy lost its tail, so the run cannot PASS

cases.title: RUN_START lost from the durable copy (ledger complete)

credibility.basis: ledger intact; durable copy lost its head

cases.title: early stop before the fork: RUN_START and RUN_END(false) only

credibility.basis: nothing happened

cases.title: empty registry, early stop

credibility.basis: no evidence

cases.title: RUN_START absent, contiguous seq, writer clean

credibility.basis: RUN_START is always the first write; ledger gapless and identical to the durable copy

cases.title: child INTENT n2 whose creator n1 is not yet registered

credibility.basis: more than one node is visible in the ledger

cases.title: RELEASED has a smaller seq than REGISTERED

credibility.basis: order visible in the ledger

cases.title: duplicate INTENT

credibility.basis: duplicate visible in the ledger

cases.title: record after RUN_END

credibility.basis: order visible in the ledger

cases.title: release written and child acted, RELEASED record never written

credibility.basis: release write and FIRST_ACTION are first-hand; ledger gapless and identical to the durable copy

cases.title: early stop, only DEAD and RUN_END missing at the tail, no release

credibility.basis: tail-only absence after an early stop

cases.title: release write succeeds, child passes the gate (the normal case)

credibility.basis: attempt, success and gate pass are three separate first-hand facts and the chain REGISTERED <= RELEASED <= before <= after <= FIRST_ACTION holds

cases.title: attempt followed by EPIPE (no reader on the gate)

credibility.basis: the failed write is first-hand (errno 32); no protocol claim; the child had already gone

cases.v2_literal: BLOCKED, but the pre-write time would count as 'release byte written'

cases.title: EPIPE after the attempt AND the durable copy lost REGISTERED

credibility.basis: ledger has REGISTERED and RELEASED; the byte was NOT written; only the file is damaged

cases.v2_literal: FAIL: F3 'no REGISTERED although release_byte_written' read the pre-write attempt and the damaged file

cases.title: release write succeeds but the child produces no FIRST_ACTION

credibility.basis: the write is first-hand; why the child did not pass the gate is unknown

cases.title: child produced FIRST_ACTION; RELEASED lost from the durable copy (ledger complete)

credibility.basis: protocol order is proven by ledger + child (first-hand); the durable copy is damaged

cases.title: child produced FIRST_ACTION; RELEASED never written; registry complete and gapless otherwise

credibility.basis: the child's FIRST_ACTION and the successful release write are first-hand; ledger gapless and identical to the file

cases.title: child produced FIRST_ACTION although the REGISTERED append failed (seq 4 consumed)

credibility.basis: contradiction between first-hand facts (append failed, yet the gate was released and passed); a G0 bench/protocol failure, with a possible instrumentation defect noted

cases.title: three-way: durable copy lost RUN_END(false) (5), ledger 6, writer_seq 6

credibility.basis: ledger complete; durable copy shorter than the ledger

cases.title: three-way: durable copy has a FOREIGN extra line (6), ledger 5, writer_seq 5

credibility.basis: a line the writer never appended: provenance broken; a verdict from the file would be unsafe

cases.v2_literal: FAIL (record after RUN_END) read from the file

cases.title: three-way: the append of RUN_END(false) itself failed (ledger 5, file 5, writer_seq 6)

credibility.basis: writer failure; the end marker was never recorded

cases.title: three-way: all differ (file 4, ledger 5, writer_seq 6)

credibility.basis: a failed append AND a lost line: nothing can be concluded from the registry

cases.title: ledger shows a duplicate RELEASED; the durable copy lost the second (positive evidence with damage)

credibility.basis: the ledger is first-hand and independent of the file damage, so the positive evidence stays credible; the damage is reported

cases.title: child produced FIRST_ACTION although the only release write failed (EPIPE)

credibility.basis: failed-write record and FIRST_ACTION are both first-hand and contradict each other: the gate was passed without a successful release (or a second writer exists)

cases.title: FIRST_ACTION earlier than the completion of the release write

credibility.basis: one monotonic clock; the child acted before the write had returned

cases.title: child passed the gate; no release attempt recorded; RELEASED is in the ledger

credibility.basis: instrumentation and child disagree; reported as an inconsistency, not as a protocol verdict

cases.title: child passed the gate; no release attempt recorded; RELEASED absent

credibility.basis: a child cannot pass the gate without a release path; ledger gapless and identical to the file

cases.title: release attempted before the RELEASED record existed

credibility.basis: ledger RELEASED.mono 1.7x is later than the attempt's mono_before 1.70

cases.note: RELEASED.mono taken as 1.72 in the ledger

cases.title: two release writes

credibility.basis: two entries in guard.release_writes

cases.title: completed run whose ledger never received DEAD and RUN_END (no append failed)

credibility.basis: completed run, writer clean, ledger identical to the file: the records were never attempted

cases.title: completed, perfect registry, but RUN_END records cleanup_confirmed=false

credibility.basis: the registry is correct; the unconfirmed cleanup is G0-C13's finding, not C03's

cases.title: REGISTERED without FORKED, writer clean; the durable copy additionally lost RUN_END(false)

credibility.basis: the hole is proven by the ledger (writer clean, no foreign line); the unrelated damage to the file does not touch the rule's witness and is reported

cases.title: REGISTERED without FORKED AND an append failed (ledger seq 1,2,4,5; reg_writer_seq 5)

credibility.basis: the absence may be explained by the failed append; integrity cannot be proven (owner policy: BLOCKED)

cases.title: REGISTERED without FORKED AND a foreign line in the durable copy

credibility.basis: witness conflict: the file contains a FORKED the writer never appended; absence-based rules are suspended

cases.title: completed clean run whose evidence conforms to V2 only (no reg_memory_records, reg_writer_seq, evidence_schema, consumed_dir, release_writes)

credibility.basis: evidence insufficient for V3

cases.v2_literal: PASS (V2-conformant evidence) -> V3 BLOCKED: the semantic change of C16

cases.title: otherwise complete clean run; evidence_schema says 'e1a-gate-g0-evidence-2'

credibility.basis: schema version mismatch: the judge refuses to guess

cases.title: otherwise complete clean run; reg_writer_seq is the string '7'

credibility.basis: wrong type counts as missing

cases.title: otherwise complete clean run; node.pid is the boolean true

credibility.basis: bool is not accepted as int

cases.title: completed run; the ledger's FORKED record carries pid=true

credibility.basis: type error inside a present record is visible in the ledger; C16 types only the container
